messages.subject: Public affairs, Middle East & Africa | Executive introduction from Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Huarte,

Your public-affairs remit across Vestas Mediterranean, including the Middle East and Africa, aligns closely with the government, stakeholder and energy-transition interface I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I work directly with ministries, regulators, communities and internal operating teams, translating external expectations into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and executive escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, and I coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I am exploring senior international roles where this combination of public affairs, government relations, stakeholder strategy and operator-side energy-transition experience could support market growth and project delivery. Vestas' Middle East and Africa priorities are especially relevant to that background.

I would value a conversation about where my experience might support your regional public-affairs or broader strategic stakeholder agenda. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Vestas.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
